Microsoft Xbox 360 Wired Controller for Windows PC - Black (High Quality Generic Copy / Plug & Play USB / Dual Vibration Feedback / Ergonomic Layout / 1-Month Store Warranty)

Enjoy classic gaming performance on PC with the Microsoft Xbox 360 Wired Controller in Black (High Quality Generic Copy), available at Turbo Computer Egypt with a 1-Month Store Warranty (ضمان شهر متجر). Designed to replicate the iconic original Xbox 360 controller layout, this controller features precise analog sticks, dual vibration feedback motors, full Windows compatibility, and plug-and-play USB connectivity for seamless PC gaming.
